data.name: Biphenyl with Water
measurement_methods: Weighed portions of the samples were inserted into a quartz cuvette and measured in a Beckman DU spectrophotometer. Absorbances were corrected for absorption of (1) onto the walls of the cuvette.
mixing_methods: A round-bottomed flask containing about 4 mL of (1) and 400 mL of (2) was evacuated, suspended in a thermostat, shaken for 24h and then allowed to settle for at least another 24h.

publication_references.citation: Bohon, R.L.; Claussen, W.F., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 1951, 73, 1571-8.
